summary: Focused re-test of the iteration_3 CRITICAL Design Pack crash. VERIFIED FIXED. Ran a full UI AI import (3 sample PDFs via /import -> generate-draft-button -> redirect in ~70s to /project/896e611c-0bee-4a3c-89f5-90dda8ce2b22, RTF-2026-0166). The imported project's Design Pack at /project/{id}/pack now renders fully: 5 PackPages (cover, section divider, existing->proposed, photographic schedule, drawing register), body text 1474 chars, pack-back visible, ZERO page/console errors. Wall build-up page is correctly omitted (imported LOFT/WIN measures have buildup but calculatedU === null) — expected per spec. Photo schedule renders 4 real extracted images (naturalWidth/Height 800x600). Regression: seeded /project/RTF-2026-0142/pack still renders all 6 pages including the Wall Build-up page with the big 0.28 W/m2K readout, target 0.30 and the green PASS badge; photo figures load at 1200/975 px. itemsBeforeIssue cap is enforced: fresh import returned exactly 12 items (GET /api/projects/{id}) and the overview shows '12 ITEMS BEFORE ISSUE'. Calculations heat-loss header now shows only '3260 W total' (long designFlowTemp prose no longer inline). Dashboard lists 15 rows and row click navigates correctly; imported overview shows 72% readiness with full content; workspace Photos (6 real photos), Survey (property table + 4-row window schedule with mm dims/orientation) and Calculations (5-room heat loss) all render. Backend pytest: 12/12 backend_test.py + 23/23 test_import.py = 35/35 pass. Database reseeded back to 8 clean projects at the end.

minor.issue: designPack.drawings is empty ([]) for AI-imported projects, so Design Pack page 6 'Drawing Register' renders an empty table with only headers and no thumbnail tiles. Cosmetic/content gap, not a crash.

issues: Page footer numbering is hardcoded to total=6 ('05 / 06'), but the wall build-up page is conditionally omitted, so imported packs show 5 pages numbered up to 06 with a gap (page numbers 5 and 6 on the last two sheets while only 5 sheets exist). Compute total from the pages actually rendered.

Existing -> Proposed Performance table has zero rows for imported projects (all calculatedU are null), leaving a large empty area above the Retrofit Strategy list. Consider an explicit 'U-value calculations pending' placeholder.

heroImage is a generic stock terraced-street photo while the property is an End-terrace bungalow; also the cover subtitle shows 'Norwich, Norfolk, NR9 3ES' whereas the overview shows 'Hethersett'. Minor consistency/authenticity nit.
Captions remain generic ('Assessment — Figure N' / 'Photograph extracted from the Assessment.') — carried over from iteration_3, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: derive the Design Pack footer page total dynamically instead of the hardcoded total=6 so numbering is contiguous when the wall build-up page is skipped.
Optional: populate designPack.drawings (or hide the Drawing Register page) for AI-imported projects.
Optional: placeholder text for the empty Existing -> Proposed table on imported packs.
critical_code_review_comments: DesignPack.jsx still dereferences p.designPack.photos / p.designPack.drawings after only guarding p.property && p.measures — if designPack is ever missing the route white-screens again; guard with p.designPack?.photos.
No React error boundary around the /pack route; any single nullable-field regression blanks the whole page. Add an ErrorBoundary so failures degrade gracefully.
process_import_job still uses asyncio.create_task with no timeout/concurrency limit (carried over from iteration_3); a hung LLM call leaves the job in 'processing' forever.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (import, imported pack, seeded pack, dashboard, overview, workspace photos/survey/calculations)

seed_data_creation: Two AI-imported projects were created during testing (UI import RTF-2026-0166 / 896e611c-0bee-4a3c-89f5-90dda8ce2b22 and one from the pytest import run). POST /api/reseed was called at the end and GET /api/projects now returns the clean 8 seeded projects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_3's CRITICAL DesignPack toFixed-on-null crash is fixed and verified for both imported and seeded projects; itemsBeforeIssue cap (<=12) verified. Sample PDFs are cached at /tmp/pdfs (assessment.pdf, scope.pdf, ashp.pdf); re-download from the review-request URLs if missing, otherwise tests/test_import.py skips. Import takes ~75s end-to-end. Remaining items are cosmetic only (pack page-total numbering, empty drawing register / existing->proposed table for imports, generic photo captions, stock hero image).
rca_of_the_issue: Previous crash root cause (now fixed): DesignPack.jsx rendered the wall build-up page for the first measure with a buildup array and called m.calculatedU.toFixed(2) although the AI import legitimately returns calculatedU === null. The fix adds `calculatedU != null && targetU != null` to both the build-up find() and the existing->proposed filter, so the page is skipped rather than throwing; confirmed no pageerror events on the imported pack and the seeded pack still shows the build-up page.
